notes: The maps people hold (simcore/command/held_map.hpp): how far a commander's decided position may stand from the point the order gives before the decision is listed as a breach of it (D3: listed, never refused), how finely the launchers' sectors are checked against the battery's, how far a line or sector is drawn, and the sheet's grid numbering.
source: game values; D3's 1 km by the owner's note (25 Nov 2026) against voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 232-239 (a pair 200-500 m apart, pairs up to 3 km)

decision_leeway_m.source: game value: D3's 1 km (the owner's note, 25 Nov 2026), a position within this of the point the order gives

coverage_step_deg.source: game value: the bearing step at which the launchers' sectors are checked against the battery's

line_range_m.source: game value: how far out an attack direction or helicopter line is drawn when the order gives no range

sector_drawn_m.source: game value: the radius a launcher's sector is drawn to on the map (about the Osa's zone)

false_easting_km.source: game value: the sheet's grid numbers are the kilometres from the map's origin plus this (as on a Soviet-pattern sheet, two figures shown)
